spans.s:
√jvar 'be hot'
present: [1.] jvarati etc. U.+ 
[perfect: jajvāra ajijvarat ajvārīt ]
future: [1.] jvariṣyati -- [2.] jvaritā 
secondary: passive: jvaryate -- intensive: jājvarya- jājūr- -- desiderative: jijvariṣa- -- causative: jvarayati etc. 
derivatives: jvara AV.+ -jvāra RV.C. 
Another form of √jval, and apparently related with jṛ, jur, jūrv.

√jval 'burn, flame'
present: [1.] jválati etc. B.+ jválate etc. E.+ 
perfect: jajvāla etc. B.+ 
aorist: [3.] ajijvalat -- [5.] ajvālīt ajvalīt 
future: [1.] jvaliṣyati B.+ -- [2.] jvalitā 
verbal: jvalita B.+ -jvalya 
secondary: intensive: jājvalīti jājvalati jājvalant jājvalyate -- desiderative: jijvaliṣa- -- causative: jvalayati etc. B.+ jvalayate jvālayati etc. S.+ jvālyate B.+ 
derivatives: jvala E.+ jvalana B.+ jvalitṛ C. jvāla S.+ jvālā E.+ jālin E.+ -jvālana C. 
Compare √jvar, of which this is another form.
